recommendations.expected_impact: Enhance the perceived value of the dining experience, making the restaurant more appealing and comfortable for guests, which can lead to longer stays and higher spending.

recommendations.issue: Perceived high pricing for value received
recommendations.action: Undertake a detailed pricing review, comparing menu prices against competitor offerings and the perceived value of dishes. Consider enhancing portion sizes, improving food presentation, or introducing value-added promotions (e.g., lunch specials, fixed-price menus) to better align price with customer expectations.
recommendations.expected_impact: Address customer concerns about value, potentially increasing sales by making the menu more attractive and competitive without necessarily reducing profit margins.
